title: Crota's End full retail raid extraction program

scope.era: Destiny 1 Rise of Iron final package set
scope.target: Deterministic extraction of the complete Crota's End raid from retail packages
scope.policy: Every subsystem must be source- or retail-byte-derived. Untyped FileHash occurrences may guide discovery but may not be promoted to ownership, identity, spawn semantics, or render semantics without a closed schema edge.

attrs.deliverable: Reusable raid package -> world + encounters + actors + animation + materials + effects + audio + portable scene pipeline

attrs.goal: Exact visible geometry, transforms, LOD/pass selection, materials and textures
Lamps, bridge, hall/council, Deathsinger, Crota finale, wipe/phase/control state
Source-owned s_entity -> model -> skeleton identities for bosses, adds, NPC-like objects and encounter actors
Exact clips, controllers, state selectors, retarget rules and exportable tracks
Exact retail texture chains and portable reconstruction of D1 material semantics
Ability/effect resources, particles/decals where extractable, Wwise/dialogue ownership and encounter audio relationships
One reproducible export manifest and scene build using only closed source-derived asset relationships

assertions.claim: The current retail Crota's End activity root is 810B0002 and the selected moon_raid_1 scenario client is 8108E004; this scenario traversal yields 282 runtime placements.
810978FC is the exact 171-entry Crota-stage SMapDataTable; its exact model owners resolve to non-rigged stage/environment/control entities rather than Crota's articulated physical body.

dark_lens.sq_crota__boss is an encounter/squad alias path whose decoded scripted table selects 8108E484, The Oversoul; the squad-controller path is not a direct serialization of Crota's physical articulated body.
Authored sequence resource 8108E52E contains darklens_ultra_spawn.sequence.tft and serializes exact s_entity FileHashes 8108E5C3 at 0xD00 and 8108E671 at 0xD18.

A package-wide printable scan of 6,636 structured entries and 33,074 printable runs in current retail package 0447 found no authored obj_crota or perf_crota string; Crota-named text is limited to squad/controller, immunity, and funeral-phase ghost-link vocabulary while ultra-Knight actor/control vocabulary is authored explicitly.

details.interpretation: Supports investigating shared ultra-Knight machinery but does not prove Crota physical identity.

assertions.claim: 8108E5C3 and 8108E671 are the current highest-value physical-actor/control frontier because they are exact s_entity FileHashes serialized by the authored darklens_ultra_spawn sequence, but neither has a first-level source-closed model or skeleton and neither is promoted as Crota without deeper typed ownership evidence.

The raid extraction program preserves typed exact ownership edges separately from untyped aligned FileHash discovery edges so deeper graph traversal cannot silently turn scalar coincidences into asset ownership.

rejections.reason: 8108E484 is source-resolved as The Oversoul and the Crota squad alias selects it as an encounter controller target; it must not be promoted as Crota's physical body.

frontiers.question: Which exact articulated s_entity/model/skeleton is Crota's physical body?
frontiers.next_proof: Recursively trace 8108E5C3 and 8108E671 while keeping typed schema edges separate from discovery-only aligned FileHashes, then close any intervening unknown controller class before promoting a discovered articulated actor.

frontiers.question: What exact world/static geometry and render-selection rules produce the complete visible Crota's End environment?
frontiers.next_proof: Apply the proven D1 map/static geometry, placement, material, LOD/pass and texture pipelines to all raid world roots and preserve encounter-specific geometry variants.

frontiers.question: How are all Crota's End encounter phases, scripted spawns and mechanics represented and connected?
frontiers.next_proof: Generalize the scripted table, squad-instance, objective/performance, lens/phase and controller-family reversals across lamps, bridge, hall/council, Deathsinger and finale resources.

frontiers.question: What is the complete source-owned actor/combatant catalog for Crota's End?
frontiers.next_proof: Enumerate every raid scenario/scripted-spawn s_entity and close exact model, skeleton, names, weapons and controller ownership with reusable graph tooling.

frontiers.question: Which exact retail animation controllers/clips drive each raid actor and mechanic?
frontiers.next_proof: Connect each closed actor skeleton to source-owned animation state/controller resources and export clips with verified retarget compatibility only.

frontiers.question: Can all raid world and actor materials be reproduced from exact retail texture/shader inputs?
frontiers.next_proof: Run exact material pointer/texture-chain recovery for raid statics and actors, preserving D1-specific control channels rather than misusing glTF COLOR_0 or reducing shaders to one base texture.

frontiers.question: What effect, ability, particle, decal, audio and dialogue dependencies belong to each raid encounter?
frontiers.next_proof: Classify reachable effect/ability and dialogue EntityResource schemas, then attach them to exact encounter/actor owners with typed relationships.

frontiers.question: How will all closed raid assets be assembled reproducibly into one portable extraction?
frontiers.next_proof: Emit a canonical raid manifest that references only proven world, placement, actor, animation, material/effect/audio relationships and drives deterministic scene export.
